_comment: Declarative family roster for `node tools/admin.mjs apply <file>`.
Copy to roster.json (gitignored — it holds real names, numbers and
addresses) and re-run it whenever someone joins: it is idempotent,
matching existing accounts by email and only adding what is missing.
email is the CREDENTIAL: sign-in mails an 8-digit code there. It must be a
mailbox the person (or the family member who sets their phone up) can
linkEveryone makes every listed person a contact of every other, which is
what a family roster is. The Apple review accounts are excluded from that
and linked only to each other — a reviewer must not see real people's
Three review accounts is deliberate: one is spent proving the
account-deletion flow (App Store 5.1.1(v)), which destroys it, and the
other two survive for the actual sign-in walkthrough.
The reviewer never opens these mailboxes: their sign-in codes are pinned
The addresses still have to be real and unique — PocketBase requires a
unique email per account — but no mail ever needs to be read from them.
